listen.description: OpenFlow connection methods the controller should listen on, e.g. pssl: for SSL/TLS or ptcp: for plain TCP.

privkey.description: Path to the controller's private key file. Required if SSL/TLS is enabled.

cert.description: Path to the certificate file for the private key. Required if SSL/TLS is enabled.

cacert.description: Path to the switch CA certificate file. Required if SSL/TLS is enabled.

daemon_opts.description: Additional options to pass to the ovs-testcontroller daemon, e.g. --hub.
